# Send a player back to Hero Select

Source: [4856](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4856); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4856-n1"></a>

- To return a player to hero select, remove their current hero from Allowed Heroes then reset hero availability; useful where no spawn room permits changing hero.

<a id="wiki-4856-n2"></a>

- Example triggers this on Interact using Ongoing Each Player.

Source limitations:

- Set Player Allowed Heroes4426 says an empty hero list has no effect, so this workaround may fail when current hero is the only allowed hero; also assess interaction with forced-hero rules.
